fixtureAdaptations.reason: New1-TC-per-province placement rule invalidates creating a second TC by command. The claim-generation scenario now explicitly relocates an existing TC in a legacy-save fixture and resets its TER1 anchors; old multiple-city saves remain loadable. All owner/claim-loss/generation/save assertions remain. Build probes select the real mobile citizen group so a reachable citizen can satisfy the new path gate.

Modes1/2 intentionally know building terrain now. A foreign-TC probe consequently fails territory2 rather than unknown3; mode0 stays unknown3. The complete natural team-fog invariant and combat/AI/stealth checks remain.
Placement preview now validates actual selected own citizens. Existing citizen selection occurs before site search, instead of relying on the former builder-free preview/placement behavior.

The research-only controlled coast is now genuine mixed land/water with an outside water outlet and sufficient land, rather than an enclosed all-water puddle. Research host foundations keep walkable separation instead of encircling the selected citizen during instant setup. All180 technologies/15 epochs and source-backed gates remain.

A premature native extractor now has exact preview error8 and returns0 before payment; the former optimistic-acknowledgement fixture is replaced by this stronger result while preserving actual no-entity/no-payment checks.
